releaseTitle: MusicDeck v3.0.9 - Interactive Frequency Response EQ Graph
releaseNotes: Introduced studio-grade interactive parametric Frequency Response EQ Graph in the Equalizer with 5 draggable frequency nodes anchored directly on the curve, live dB tooltips, tactile 0 dB haptic snapping, bidirectional slider sync, preset morphing animations, and background Real-Time Analyzer (RTA) audio spectrum.
